0006.title: S-BS-19 blockrun-nano-recovery — 3 FAIL / 3 HOLD (wave 4)
0006.subject: @blockrun/nano-client 0.8.0 (npm exact pin)
0006.summary: Battery against the published SDK: a shape-only payTo check signs the authorization over an attacker-controlled recipient; the default config has no spend cap (×50 signed); a lost response is a recovery dead-end whose only exit is a retry that mints a fresh nonce — a second economic execution. Three genuine guards (decimal, contract pin, replay) hold.

findings.text: payTo substitution passes the shape-only check; signature produced over attacker payTo.
No default spend cap: authorization signed for ×50 of requirements price; cap is opt-in.
Lost-response recovery dead-end; manual retry = second economic execution, contradicting the README claim.

0007.title: S-BS-20 nevermined-credit-recovery — 7 FAIL / 1 DX / 3 HOLD (wave 5)
0007.subject: @nevermined-io/payments 1.13.0 (npm exact pin)
0007.summary: Eleven probes against the published payment middleware: lost-response retry double-charges on the default token; single-use enforcement is per-process and reactive (concurrent race delivers a free service); any settle failure except one special case delivers the resource unpaid; verify reserves nothing; streamed responses never carry a settlement receipt. Three controls hold — including a genuinely well-built byte-delta disconnect probe.

findings.text: Lost-response retry double-charges on the default v2 token; receipt attached only to the lost response.
Single-use guard is per-process and reactive; multi-replica sellers have no guard at all.
Any settle failure except 0059 delivers unpaid; the documented 200+success:false shape even receives a receipt.
Verify checks balance but reserves nothing: depletion race delivers the second service free.
Streamed responses carry no settlement receipt, ever; reconciliation impossible on the dominant endpoint shape.
Silent v3→v2 downgrade on mint: buyer wants single-use, silently holds a reusable credential.

0009.title: mcp-tool-idempotency external verification — v0.2.0 fixes hold (10/10)
0009.subject: tripl3tr3s/mcp-tool-idempotency (public repo, unmodified)
0009.summary: The cooperative model working end-to-end: three durability windows (lost response after commit, crash after commit, cross-instance race) reported via coordinated disclosure; the maintainer shipped owner-gated claim leases and released v0.2.0; the lab verified the fix with a ten-window battery — 10/10 PASS, suite 91/91 at tag. Credited in the project's SECURITY.md.

findings.text: Lost response after commit: retry re-fires the committed side effect — documented at-least-once limit (‘failed executions are never cached’); fixed in v0.2.0.
Crash after commit: dead holder's pending row unconditionally reset by the next caller — shares F3's root cause (missing liveness check), narrow crash window; fixed in v0.2.0.
Cross-instance race: claim loser resets the winner's LIVE pending row (fixed in v0.2.0).

0012.title: S-BS-06 cycle 3 — PR #3920 @ e993bef re-pin re-run: green zone holds, A10c/d + A12/A13 PASS (17/19)
0012.subject: x402-foundation/x402
0012.summary: The re-pin re-run required by the acceptance protocol after the recipient-normalization commits: full 19-session re-run at e993bef, no head mixing. Green zone A1–A9 and the A11 fail-closed rejection are unchanged. Two NEW pre-registrations go green: conflicting-offer races A10c/A10d (one commitment + one pre-signer rejection — the in-thread requested discriminating control) and case-variant recipient A12/A13 (case spelling no longer mints a fresh quote key; raised case-variant rejected pre-signer). Identical-offer A10a/A10b continues the cycle-2 pre-registration for continuity — duplicate-payment semantics per the PR author's in-thread position, outside the quote-control layer's scope.

findings.text: Identical-offer first-contact race persists at e993bef: signer ×2 (8/7 ms apart) before any slot completes; verdict continues the cycle-2 pre-registration for continuity — author's position: duplicate-payment semantics, out of quote-control scope; the discriminating control A10c/A10d passes.

A12/A13 verify the e993bef normalization delta: case-variant offers ride the canonicalized quote-ledger anchor — no false positive at unchanged amount; raised case-variant rejected pre-signer where case-sensitive cycle-2 keys would have signed as a fresh key.

0013.title: Boundary: product layer moved private — public repository remains proof-only (registry + verification + site)
0013.subject: igor-vii/Argus-Agent-Test-Lab
0013.summary: The open-core boundary, sealed as a chain event. Engine, scenario library, SUT harnesses and engagement archives moved to a private repository (157 files, ~1.5 MB) — a forward-only split: no history rewrite, no force-push. The last public snapshot (efbf51e) is hash-pinned by a manifest, which is this record's evidence; every file that moved carries its sha256, so any future disclosure of product code stays verifiable against what was public. All 49 sealed evidence paths, the site, the verify tooling and everything referenced from public threads remain public and byte-identical.
